long_term_goal: GPT-grade general language understanding without an external LLM reasoning dependency
implemented: predicate-frame extraction for Korean and English
interrogative propositions lowered to investigation rather than execution
competing interpretation lattice with fail-closed clarification
definition-grounded injection of previously unknown predicates
projection of the selected structural interpretation into the existing GoalIR path

architecture.language_reasoning_path: surface -> compositional frames/scopes -> interpretation candidates -> pragmatic goal -> GoalIR -> existing reasoner

development_counterexamples.observed: Korean irregular form 고쳐 was initially not bound to the repair predicate.
development_counterexamples.repair: Expanded the predicate morphology family rather than adding a sentence template.

development_counterexamples.observed: An outer passive predicate was initially absorbed into metalinguistic quotation scope.
development_counterexamples.repair: Separated quoted inner predicates from the passive matrix predicate.

development_counterexamples.observed: Please incorrectly promoted every later predicate in the same clause to an imperative.
development_counterexamples.repair: Bound directive force to the predicate immediately governed by the directive prefix.

development_counterexamples.observed: A declarative mention such as deployment after an error was initially promoted as an execution goal.
development_counterexamples.repair: Made bare declarative action mentions non-authoritative unless explicit necessity is present.

known_limits: This is a deterministic structural language layer, not a pretrained general language model.
Built-in morphology and predicate vocabulary remain compact; injected predicates are process-local in R3.
Long-distance syntax, quantifier scope, nested coreference, and culturally novel implicature remain limited.
Equal-strength compound requests currently request clarification instead of producing a multi-goal ordered graph.
Only controlled Korean and English generalization has been measured.
No large open-domain or human preference benchmark has been run, so GPT-grade competence is not claimed.
next_frontier: tamper-evident persistence for learned predicates and grammar knowledge
dependency and semantic-role graphs for nested clauses and multi-goal ordering
quantifier, temporal, and cross-turn coreference scope
large frozen adversarial blind suite with family-held-out paraphrases
grounded open-domain knowledge acquisition without solution leakage
